entries.text: I wish I could show you, when you are lonely or in darkness, the astonishing light of your own being.
Even after all this time, the sun never says to the earth, "You owe me." Look what happens with a love like that. It lights the whole sky.
Fear is the cheapest room in the house. I would like to see you living in better conditions.
The words you speak become the house you live in.
Your heart and my heart are very, very old friends.
Stay close to anything that makes you glad you are alive.
I caught the happy virus last night when I was out singing beneath the stars. It is remarkably contagious.
A poet is someone who can pour light into a cup, then raise it to nourish your beautiful parched, holy mouth.
Don't surrender your loneliness so quickly. Let it cut more deep. Let it ferment and season you as few human or even divine ingredients can.
We have not come here to take prisoners, but to surrender ever more deeply to freedom and joy.
The heart is a thousand-stringed instrument that can only be tuned with Love.
All this time the sun never says to the earth, you owe me.
I am a hole in a flute that the Christ's breath moves through — listen to this music.
Ever since happiness heard your name, it has been running through the streets trying to find you.
How did the rose ever open its heart and give to this world all its beauty? It felt the encouragement of light against its being.
